main.description: Self-nomination for the etzhayyim Bootstrap Council (Seats 2-5). Per ADR-2605192300 §1-§2. Submitted via PDS during the 30-day public objection period. Founder reviews + selects from applications; objection mechanism is a separate Lexicon (com.etzhayyim.apps.etzhayyim.council-objection).

candidateDid.description: Candidate's DID (did:web / did:plc / did:key). Must control the SBT if already an Adherent.

candidateLegalName.description: Optional legal name. Candidates may apply pseudonymously.

seatAxis.description: Which of Seats 2-5 the candidate applies for. Per ADR-2605192300 §1: Seat 2 = Substrate/Technology, Seat 3 = Legal/Ethics, Seat 4 = Economics, Seat 5 = Stewardship/Land.

candidateNarrative.description: Self-introduction. Why this seat. Alignment with Mission Charter (ADR-2605192100). Public record.

evidenceUri.description: URL / IPFS CID / AT URI of supporting evidence.

smartWalletAddress.description: 0x-prefixed ERC-4337 Smart Account address. Will become the Council seat's on-chain identity.

existingSbtTokenId.description: Optional — Adherent SBT tokenId if candidate is already enrolled (recommended but not required).

conflictOfInterestDisclosure.description: Public COI disclosure. Material conflicts must be declared; non-disclosure is grounds for objection.

riderComplianceDeclaration.description: Candidate affirms they do not publicly represent any entity that falls into Charter Rider §2(a)-(h) prohibited categories. Required true.

candidateSignature.description: DID-bound signature over (seatAxis, candidateNarrative, qualifications, smartWalletAddress) digest.

founderRecognitionUri.description: Set by Founder after the objection period if this application is selected. Empty otherwise.
